spans.s:
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Indistinct, unapparent, invisible, imperceptible.
2 In algebra, unknown as quantity or number.
m. (क्त)
1 VIṢṆ
Ś

IVA.
3
KANDARPA or

CUPID.
4

A fool.
n. (-क्तं)
1 The Supreme Being or universal spirit.
2 Any invisible principle according to the Sāṃkhya philosophy.
3 The soul.
4 Nature, temperament.
E.
अ neg. व्यक्त evident, distinct.

f. (-या)
Algebraic calculation.
2 Any act of an indistinct character or aim.
E.
अव्यक्त and क्रिया act.

m. (-गः)
Dark-red, the colour of the dawn.
E.
अव्यक्त indistinct, and राग colour.

f. (-शिः)
An unknown number or indistinct quantity, (in algebra.)
E.
अव्यक्त and राशि quantity.

n. (म्यं)
Equation of unknown quantities.
E.
अव्यक्त and साम्य equality.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
1 Steady, cool, deliberate.
2 Indifferent, undisturbed.
E.
अ neg. व्यग्र hurried.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Plain, not figurative.
2 Perfect, not mutilated.
f. (-ङ्गा)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens, Rox.)
E.
अ neg. वि priv. and अङ्ग the body, or व्यङ्ग figure of speech.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Well made, symmetrical, perfect, entire.
E.
अव्यङ्ग not defective, अङ्ग a limb.

Indistinct.
2

Plain, not figurative.
m. (-नः)
An animal without horns, though of an age to have them. अ neg. व्यञ्जन a mark or figure.

f. (-ण्डा)
A plant, (Carpopogon pruriens.)

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Distinct, specific, separate, unmixed.
E.
अ neg. व्यतिकीर्ण confounded, mixed.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Free from pain.
2 Merciful, not inflicting pain.
m. (-थः)
A snake.
f. (-था)
1 Yellow myrobalan.
2 Another plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) See पद्मचारिणी.
E.
अ neg. व्यथा pain.

m. (-थिः)
A horse, (in the dialect of the Vedas.)
E.
अ neg, व्यथ to pain, and इन् affix; who does not tire in war, &c.

m. (-धीः)
1 The earth.
2 Night.

mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि)
Free from pain.
2 Not inflicting pain.
E.
अ neg. व्यथा pain, इनि aff.

m. (-षः)
1 The ocean.
2 The sun.
f. (-षी)
1 The earth.
2 Midnight.
E.
अ neg. व्यथ to suffer pain, and टिषच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
1 Free from pain.
2 Not paining, not giving pain.
E.
अ neg. व्यथ to feel pain, and क्यप् affix irr.

m. (-रः)
Steadiness, consistency, constancy.
E.
अ neg व्यभिचार irregularity.

Constant.
2

Virtuous, moral.
3 Steady, permanent, faithful.
E.
अ neg. व्यभिचारिन् variable.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Economical, parsimonious.
2 Unexpended, unwasted.
3 Imperishable, immutable, eternal.
m. (-यः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
mn. (-यः-यं)
An indeclinable word, a particle.
E.
अ neg. and व्यय expenditure.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Eternal, imperishable.
m. (त्मा)
Soul, spirit.
E.
अव्यय undecayed, आत्मन् self.

m. (-वः)
1 Imperishableness.
2 An indeclinable compound.
E.
अव्यय and भाव disposition, with च्चि inserted.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Profitable, fruitful.
2 Effectual, efficacious.
E.
अ neg. व्यर्थ useless.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
True, veracious.
E.
अ neg. व्यलीक false.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Close, contiguous.
2 Careless.
E.
अ neg. व्यवधान any thing interposed, or carefulness.

Contiguity.
2

Carelessness.
E.
तल् added to with the last; also with त्व, अव्यवधानत्वं.

m. (-यः)
Negligence, inactivity.
E.
अ neg. व्यवसाय employment.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Negligent, remiss in practice.
E.
अ neg. व्यवसाय practice, profession, मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Negligent, inactive, remiss.
E.
अ neg. व्यवसाय business, इनि aff.

f. (-स्था)
1 Irregularity, deviation from established rule.
2 Incorrect legal opinion.
E.
अ neg. व्यवस्था law.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Not conformable to law or practice.
2 Unacquainted with the law or custom.
3 Ill regulated.
4 Displaced, disordered.
E.
अ neg. and व्यवस्थित ordained.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Unactionable, not to be discussed in law.
E.
अ neg. व्यवहार्य्य actionable.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Adjoining, contiguous.
E.
अ neg. and व्यवहित divided.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Not determined or investigated by law.
2 Not spoken.
E.
अ neg. व्यवहृत tried.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Moral, correct, free from vice.
E.
अ neg. व्यसन evil practices.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Free from evil practices, steady, correct.
E.
अ neg. व्यसन evil practices, इनि aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Simple, undecomposed.
2 Undispersed, collected.
E.
अ neg. व्यस्त scattered.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Calm, firm, composed.
E.
अ neg. व्याकुल flurried.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Undecomposed, simple.
n. (-तं)
Elementary substance from which all things were created, considered as one with the substance of BRAHMA.
E.
अ neg. व्याकृत separated, decomposed.

f. (-ख्या)
Obscurity, want of clearness or explanation.
E.
अ neg. आख्या explanation.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unexplained, obscure.
E.
अ neg. व्याख्यात explained.

n. (-नं)
Absence of explicitness, want of explanation.
E.
अ neg. व्याख्यान explanation.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Unintelligible, inexplicable.
2 Easy, not requiring to be explained.
E.
अ neg. व्याख्येय to be explained.

m. (-जः)
Absence of fraud, simplicity, honesty.
E.
अ, and व्याज disguise.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Special, individual, peculiar.
E.
अ neg. व्यापक generick.

n. (-त्वं)
Speciality, individuality, non-comprehensiveness or generalization.
E.
अव्यापक special, and त्व affix; also अव्यापकता.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Inexpert, inexperienced.
m. (-रः)
Business not practised or understood.
E.
अ not, व्यापार business.

n. (-त्वं)
Speciality, non-generalization.
E.
अ neg. व्यापिन् what pervades, त्व affix; also अव्यापिता.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
1 Special, individual.
2 Limited, partial, not comprehensive.
E.
अ neg. व्यापिन् pervading.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Peculiar, individual, limited.
E.
अ neg. व्याप्त diffused.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
Peculiar, not to be extended generally.
E.
अ neg. व्याप्य to be extended.

mfn. (-त्तिः)
In logic, A category of individual application, and influenced by place and time, as pain, pleasure, love, hatred, virtue, vice, &c.
E.
अ neg. व्याप्य diffusive, general, and वृत्ति being.

m. (-मः)
Absence of lassitude or fatigue.
E.
अ neg. व्यायाम exertion.

n. (-नं)
Not returning, not coming back, not circulating.
E.
अ neg. व्यावर्त्तन returning, revolving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unresisted, unimpeded.
2 Not disappointed.
E.
अ neg. व्याहत baffled.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Undisputed.
E.
अ neg. व्याहित disputed.
